title: Saved View Filters Payload Import Export Finalization

next_recommendation.title: Saved View Import Export Format Version Contract
next_recommendation.reason: Lossless filters import and export is now finalized. The next safe step is an explicit format-version contract so future CSV columns can evolve with deterministic compatibility and migration rules.

guardrails: Do not modify the Phase 72B implementation in this finalization phase.
filters_summary must remain human-readable only and must never be parsed for imported filters.
filters_payload must remain the sole machine-readable filters source.
filters_payload must decode to a JSON object before writes.
Invalid JSON and JSON lists must block all import writes.
Legacy CSV files without filters_payload must remain supported with empty filters.
Import apply must remain protected by a database transaction.
Imported saved views must remain scoped to the authenticated user.
Duplicates must be skipped without overwriting existing saved views.
Preserve import preview, import apply, CSV export, bulk selection, and pagination behavior.
